interface_detail: REST API, CLI and a web console; SSH into a pod
tooling: runpodctl, the RunPod API, Docker images, network volumes
chaining: a GPU pod is a server with a GPU, so it can hold a model and serve it; the free tier does not exist
limits_note: storage from USD 0.05 per GB a month on standard network storage

free_tier.stated: no free GPU tier is published; the on-demand card list runs from an RTX A5000 at USD 0.16 an hour on Community Cloud to a B300 at USD 8.99 on Secure Cloud, across 21 cards
free_tier.notes: Community Cloud is cheaper than Secure Cloud for the same card; the page carries a per-hour and a per-second toggle, and 21 on-demand cards were read on 2026-10-24

retention.stated: network storage is billed while it exists; a pod keeps its volume only while attached or persisted

egress.terms: not published as a per-GB line on the page read

limits.value: no free tier; the cheapest published card is billed per second
up to 64 GPUs in a cluster; 8 vCPU and 8 GiB is not the shape on offer

identity_cost.detail: a card is required to launch a pod

evidence.proved: on-demand B300 at USD 6.94/h on Community Cloud and USD 8.99/h on Secure Cloud; H200 at USD 3.59 and USD 5.29
network storage starts at USD 0.05 per GB a month

the full on-demand card list, Community and Secure, quoted from the page's own rate data: RTX A5000 0.16/0.27, RTX 3090 0.22/0.50, RTX A6000 0.33/0.59, RTX 4090 0.34/0.89, A40 0.35/0.59, L4 0.44/0.59, Pro 6000 MIG 24GB 0.50/0.69, L40 0.69/0.82, RTX 5090 0.69/1.19, RTX 6000 Ada 0.74/0.99, L40S 0.79/1.09, Pro 6000 MIG 48GB 1.00/1.29, A100 PCIe 1.19/1.79, A100 SXM 1.39/1.79, RTX Pro 6000 1.69/2.49, H100 PCIe 1.99/2.89, H100 NVL 2.59/3.19, H100 SXM 2.69/3.99, H200 3.59/5.29, B200 5.98/7.99, B300 6.94/8.99. session_cap.note: none; a pod runs until stopped

keep_rate.basis: a stopped pod does not bill compute, only storage

network_out.ports: a TCP port map and a proxy

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 0.16/h is the cheapest card on the page read on 2026-10-24 (RTX A5000, Community Cloud); 10 h = USD 1.60 and 730 h = USD 116.80.

binding_note: billing is per second with no free allowance, so the metered rate is what binds; there is no quota to exhaust
